evidence_events.title: Priya review on PR #38: In-memory cache cannot scale across replicas
evidence_events.body: Local LRU will never solve cache stampedes across multiple container replicas. Each pod will maintain cold caches. We need a distributed Redis cluster.

evidence_events.author: priya_patel
evidence_events.title: ADR 0009: Migrate to Redis Cluster for Distributed Caching
evidence_events.body:
Status: accepted

Context:
In-memory LRU caching caused node OOM crashes (#34) and replica cache incoherence. PR #38 attempted local memory capping but was rejected because container autoscaling requires shared cache state.

Decision:
Decommission in-memory LRU dict in store.py and implement Redis cluster client with sentinel failover and connection pooling.

Consequences:
- Resilient distributed cache state across all container instances.
- Solves memory leak and OOM termination.
- Network overhead ~1.2ms per roundtrip.

evidence_events.author: sarah_chen
evidence_events.title: ADR 0004: Adopt Discrete PID Algorithm for Thermal Regulation
evidence_events.body:
Status: accepted

Context:
Previous bang-bang / on-off controller caused severe thermal oscillations and triggered chamber shutdown (Issue #12). Deadband tuning was tested and rejected because it increased control latency by 17% and failed transient tests.

Decision:
Implement discrete PID control with anti-windup clamping in regulate_temperature(). Use scipy interpolation for telemetry curve smoothing.

Consequences:
- Smooth thermal trajectory within +/- 0.4C of setpoint.
- Added dependency on scipy.
- Slightly higher CPU compute per control cycle.

decision.title: Reject Simple Deadband Hysteresis for Thermal Control
decision.rationale: Tested in simulation following Issue #12; deadband was insufficient to prevent emergency chamber thermal trip.

evidence_events.title: Marcus on Issue #12: Proposed deadband tuning
evidence_events.body: We could tighten the deadband on the simple threshold on-off controller to +/- 1.5C. That requires zero external math libraries.

evidence_events.author: sarah_chen
evidence_events.title: Sarah on Issue #12: Benchmark results against deadband tuning
evidence_events.body: I benchmarked deadband tuning in simulation. It increased latency by 17% and still caused a 6.2C overshoot on rapid thermal transient. We must reject on-off hysteresis and move to continuous PID control.
